record.title: On Explaining Random Forests with SAT
record.reason: SAT-based random-forest explanation is evaluated for solver/explanation performance across a broad UCI/Penn benchmark suite. Medical/biological tasks such as thyroid, appendicitis, E. coli, and heart classification coexist with banknotes, glass, letters, ionosphere, and other generic tasks; the research is not biomedical-primary.
pdf_sections_reviewed: Experimental assessment setup and Table 1 benchmark suite

record.title: Reinforcement Learning for Route Optimization with Robustness Guarantees
record.reason: Robust route optimization for capacitated vehicle routing and traveling salesperson problems; no biomedical experiment.

record.title: Learning CNF Theories Using MDL and Predicate Invention
record.reason: Learning/compressing CNF theories evaluated on synthetic logical theories and mixed UCI classification benchmarks. Hepatitis, heart, dermatology, Pima, and other biological/medical data are secondary parts of general compression/classification tests alongside glass, wine, vehicles, games, and industrial data.
pdf_sections_reviewed: Sections 7.1–7.3 experimental framing, compression/classification benchmarks and results table

record.title: Learning to Learn Personalized Neural Network for Ventricular Arrhythmias Detection on Intracardiac EGMs
record.reason: The central task is personalized detection of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias from intracardiac electrograms for implantable defibrillators. Experiments use expert-annotated Ann Arbor electrogram recordings from patients, comparing personalized neural detection with clinical criteria and other methods.
pdf_sections_reviewed: Section 4.1 Dataset and Data Preprocessing; 4.3 Methods Evaluated

record.title: SalientSleepNet: Multimodal Salient Wave Detection Network for Sleep Staging
record.reason: The central task is physiological sleep-stage assessment from EEG/EOG recordings. SalientSleepNet is evaluated on Sleep-EDF-39 and Sleep-EDF-153, learning multimodal salient waves and sleep-stage transitions for sleep assessment.
pdf_sections_reviewed: Section 5.1 Datasets and Preprocessing; 5.4 Experiment Results framing
